claims: Over 10 million pounds of Trader Joe's frozen fried rice and chicken shu mai are recalled as of March 2026.
The recall is due to potential contamination with hard plastic or glass pieces.
Affected products were produced by Ajinomoto Foods.
Affected products were sold nationwide except in 7 states.
Trader Joe's Vegetable Fried Rice has best by dates 02/28/2026 to 11/19/2026.
Trader Joe's Chicken Fried Rice has best by dates 03/04/2026 to 02/10/2027.
Trader Joe's Japanese Style Fried Rice has best by dates 02/28/2026 to 11/14/2026.
Trader Joe's Chicken Shu Mai has best by dates 03/13/2026 to 10/23/2026.
The recall was initiated due to numerous consumer complaints regarding foreign objects.
Foreign objects were identified as glass ranging from 1-3 cm in length.
The glass likely originated from carrots in the products.
The FDA lists the recall under a serious potential health consequence classification.
